webProvenance.captureScope: Before and after the complete suite

scope: Actual local PostgreSQL membership, Authentication Emulator Google SDK flows, session/CSRF/proxy boundaries and browser HTTPS cookie policy
providerSmoke: Not a configured real Google provider smoke

tests.title: real author/editor/admin sessions retain five-day HttpOnly cookies and enforce backend roles
uninvited and stale-auth identities cannot mint a web session
CSRF rejects missing, forged, stale-session and cross-origin tokens; login replaces a fixed session
proxy ignores browser identity assertions, arbitrary paths and unbounded bodies
a browser bearer assertion cannot change the cookie identity and cross-author drafts remain unavailable
invitation landings scrub both token URL formats before HTML and protect redirect continuity
invitation mismatch preserves the invitation; matching verified identity accepts once and then exchanges a session
expired invitations and expired session claims retain clear authoritative denial
live SQL disablement and provider revocation stop previously issued sessions
HTTPS staging policy creates browser-accepted Host cookies and hides the session from scripts
the actual Google SDK emulator popup supports cancellation, memory-only sign-in and warned logout export
failed staff storage clearance leaves the existing session available for recovery
the actual Google SDK redirect restores invitation and CSRF continuity after a blocked popup
rotated CSRF during Google sign-in recovers with a fresh context and real popup retry
an invalid redirect return offers a clean restart rather than repeating the callback
a mismatched Google popup account can switch to the invited account without consuming its link

cleanup.scope: Only the recorded disposable identity containers and network were stopped; saved volumes were not used.
